candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order /v1/orders returns HTTP 500, so the order service is the failing dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; the internal cause of the order 500 (db, payment, inventory) is not established.

report.explanation: Every checkout 502 is paired with a gateway client call to order /v1/orders returning 500 in ~15-100ms, and topology confirms gateway->order. Fast failures point to an order-side error rather than gateway latency; the specific order-internal cause needs order-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for /v1/orders to identify the internal failure cause
Dependency metrics for order->postgresql, order->payment, order->inventory to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
